description: This file defines a custom RecyclerView.ItemDecoration class called HorizontalSpaceItemDecoration, which adds consistent spacing between horizontally scrolling items in a RecyclerView.

classes.name: HorizontalSpaceItemDecoration
classes.description: A class that adds fixed space between horizontally-scrolling RecyclerView items by overriding getItemOffsets.

methods.name: getItemOffsets
methods.description: Overrides RecyclerView.ItemDecoration.getItemOffsets to apply spacing around RecyclerView items based on position.
